findings.rule: A `style:` commit that reflows must be listed in the blame-ignore file; CI checks that after merge.
findings.input: A PR whose commit `style: rewrap` reflows README.md and is not listed in .git-blame-ignore-revs, merged to main
findings.finding: No CI job checks after merge that a reflowing `style:` commit is listed in `.git-blame-ignore-revs`, so the unlisted commit lands with no finding. The PR body declares this gap.

findings.rule: Both hooks ship in the rendered template and run in the prek CI job.
findings.input: A rendered repo's prek CI job (`uvx prek run --all-files`) on a PR commit that reflows README.md under a `docs:` subject
findings.finding: Neither hook runs in the prek CI job: reflow-guard is a commit-msg-stage hook, and guillemets-in-code sees no staged diff under `--all-files`. The check moves to a separate prose-diff job instead. The PR body declares this departure.

findings.rule: Guillemet hook: fails on a `.py`, `.mjs` or `.sh` file with a guillemet; passes on `.md` files.
findings.input: The PR-range CI job (`--range base..head`) over a commit that adds `x «name»` to `docs/meeting notes.md` (a Markdown path containing a space)
findings.finding: For a path containing a space, git ends the `+++ b/<path>` header with a tab. The path the script keeps then ends in a tab, the `\.md(\.jinja)?$` exemption does not match, and range mode reports a guillemet in a Markdown file.

findings.rule: A guillemet in a source file, code comment or help text is a finding.
findings.input: A PR commit that adds `echo "«name»"` to `scripts/ci/run.sh`, checked by the PR-range CI job
findings.finding: The VENDORED pattern drops every hunk under `scripts/ci/` (and CHANGELOG.md, .all-contributorsrc) before the guillemet check runs, so a guillemet added to a shell source file there passes.
